App.Title: ScaleBridge — Bluetooth weight-scale receiver
Banner.Demo: DEMO DATA: the Fake demo adapter is active. Every reading is scripted demo data, not a real weight, and no real Bluetooth device is involved.
Banner.Experimental: Experimental (implemented from the spec only, not verified on real hardware): parsing of the standard Weight Scale 0x181D / Body Composition 0x181B services is covered by byte-vector tests only and has not been verified on any real scale.
Col.Name: Name
History.Summary: Showing {0} of {1} records (newest first; exports always include all records)
Set.AdapterStage2: This adapter belongs to phase 2 and is not implemented in this version: it will not scan or connect to anything. Use the demo adapter.
Set.Privacy: Local only: this program makes no network requests and has no telemetry. History and settings are stored only on this computer in the directory below (SQLite):
Set.Keys: Keyboard: Tab / arrows / Space / Enter operate controls; F5 starts scanning, Esc stops, Ctrl+1…4 switch tabs.
Status.AdapterStage2: This adapter is a phase 2 item and not implemented yet.
Status.BlePermission: Bluetooth permission denied; allow it in system settings and retry.
Status.BleUnavailable: Bluetooth is unavailable: no adapter or Bluetooth is turned off.
Live.Waiting: Waiting for weight data… (scan and connect on the Devices tab first)
Live.Abnormal: The weight is outside the usual 2–200 kg range; it was saved but flagged, please check it.
Live.ClockSuspect: The device's own clock differs a lot from this computer's (it may have been reset); saved as-is and flagged.
Live.Duplicate: This measurement duplicates a saved record and was not saved again.
Live.ZeroNotSaved: The reading is 0 and is not saved by policy.
Live.Unsuccessful: The device reported a failed measurement (0xFFFF); nothing was saved. Please weigh again.
Live.ParseError: Received a packet that could not be parsed ({0}): {1}. Ignored; still listening.
Dlg.DeleteBody: Delete the {0} checked records? This cannot be undone.
Dlg.ClearBody: Clear all {0} history records? This cannot be undone.
